subject: SIG: Key Custody Sampling Plan & Evidence Bundle Delivery
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helioshealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alec Park <alec.park@helioshealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG: Key custody sampling plan and evidence request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the call earlier — Helios is preparing our SIG questionnaire responses and we need a targeted evidence bundle specifically for encryption/key management (keys in KMS, HSM attestations, at-rest/in-transit controls, and rotation sampling). Our security team will sample 3 months of rotation events and ask for proof-of-rotation, KMS IAM role snapshots, and a recent HSM attestation.

Concrete ask: can you provide the following by EOD next week (2026-12-10)?
- A short design doc (1-2 pages) describing key custody and where customer data keys live (KMS vs HSM vs wrapped keys)
- Sampling set: rotation events for Oct–Nov–Nov 2026 (CSV) and a sampling plan explaining how items were selected
- HSM attestation or vendor statement showing FIPS/HSM vendor timestamp and serial/instance IDs
- IAM role matrix for KMS key access (who can rotate/delete/view) as of 2026-12-01
- TLS in-transit config summary (ciphers, minimum TLS version) and a tracing example from a recent session

Also note any redaction or export constraints we should be aware of (e.g., redacted principal IDs or truncated logs). If helpful I can accept a secure Drive link or a zipped package via DocuSign/Portal.

Appreciate it — Olivia
Security Engineer, Helios Health

[Attachment: helio_SIG_scope.pdf (pdf, 42 KB)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: Key custody sampling plan and evidence request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a scoped evidence bundle by 2026-12-10. Plan below:

Deliverables (what we'll provide)
- Architecture brief: "Key custody and wrapping model" (PDF, ~2 pages)
- Sampling CSV: rotation_schedule_2026.csv (rotations for Oct/Nov 2026) + brief sampling rationale
- HSM attestation: vendor-signed PDF for the HSM cluster that handles envelope-wrapping (redact serials where required)
- KMS access matrix: kms_role_matrix.xlsx (IAM snapshots as of 2026-12-01)
- TLS summary: cipher suites and an example session trace (redacted IPs)
- Sample logs: kv-cache-sample-logs_202611.zip (redacted principal IDs)

Notes/constraints:
- We will replace exact tenant IDs with stable pseudonyms in the sample logs.
- HSM vendor policy prevents exporting raw hardware private key material; attestation PDF and public certificate chain are what we can provide.
- If you require original principal ARNs for audit, we'll need a signed NDA amendment — otherwise we will provide masked ARNs and a step-by-step validation runbook.

Karthik/Sean — looping you in to confirm quick exports and to coordinate the attestation pull. I will assemble the zip and upload to a secure Drive folder; will send a DocuSign link for secure download if requested.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: internal_checklist.txt (text, 3 KB)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Helios SIG evidence — who owns which artifact?

Karthik / Sean — quick split of labor:
- Karthik: export rotation events CSV for Oct/Nov 2026 (include rotation_time, key_id, initiator_principal, change_type). Mask principal IDs per the checklist. Please also snapshot KMS policy versions for the affected keys.
- Sean: pull the HSM vendor attestation PDF (we have vendor portal access) and the public cert chain, confirm serials that are safe to disclose. Also provide a short note on our envelope-wrapping flow (where HSM is used vs cloud-KMS).

Timeline: please have your artifacts in the shared evidence folder by EOD tomorrow (2026-12-04) so I can assemble and run a final QA on 12/05.

Thanks — Priya

Hi Olivia — attaching the scoped evidence bundle and links below. We assembled a sampled set that matches your request; artifacts are redacted as discussed.

What we delivered (zipped and Drive link):
- evidence_bundle_SIG_helio_20261203.zip (contains: key_custody_design.pdf, rotation_schedule_2026.csv, kms_role_matrix.xlsx, hsm_attestation_2026.pdf, kv-cache-sample-logs_202611.zip, tls_trace_20261122.txt)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-evidence-Helios (access: link restricted; we granted view to olivia.chen@helioshealth.com)
- HubSpot ticket: HS-98217 (attached export)
- Secure download (DocuSign envelope): https://redwood-docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-4592 (exp 7 days)

Observations / clarifications
- HSM attestation includes vendor statement and certificate chain; serials are partially redacted to comply with vendor export rules.
- Rotation CSV uses masked actor IDs; if Helios requires full ARNs for audit, please confirm the signed access need and we can discuss an NDA addendum.
- TLS: we documented TLS v1.2+ with enforced modern ciphers; sample trace shows session negotiation and server cert chain.

Next steps
- Please confirm receipt and whether Helios needs any additional fields or original ARNs (and we will escalate to legal if necessary).
- Happy to do a short walkthrough (20–30 min) next week to talk through the artifacts.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
